changes.commit_title: rules: SQL sinks and sources for DB wrappers, finders, builders and bound requests
changes.controls: pass on 1.15.0 and 2.1.0; 10 positives none reported by b2a2800f; matrix 302 -> 312 after rebase
changes.first_version_rejected: A first version raised the benign controls from 31 to 58 (+27): ADOdb execute() matched composer ProcessExecutor::execute([...]) and grav PDO execute([...]) (+21), the NAME label reached phpBB "UPDATE $table SET $column = ..." through associative concatenation (+4) and the builder method list matched hugo filepath.Join (+2). Fixed by receiver/array limits, NAME only on the interpolated quoted-value sink, and dropping Join/Set/SetMore/SQL/From/Or/Not; each pinned by an ok control. The tightened version replaced it before push.
changes.note: GHSA-jjgq is an extra gain: the fix deletes $sql .= " AND d.fk_statut = ".$statut with $statut from $_GET. OpenGrep 1.15.0 does not evaluate taint sinks on the right of $arr[] = ...; the pimcore fragments are recovered on 2.1.0 and the controls use plain assignments.
